nurse.text: {greeting} Welcome to Enniskillen Sanctuary. Pop them on the counter there and I'll have them right as rain. Which, round here, is the default.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There's a pot of tea on, and a plate of boxty if you're quick.
All grand. Away you go, and mind the swans on the bridge. They think they own it. They might.
The Ark's in the corner. It's been on the lough so long it's half boat.

else.text: No bother at all. Come back any time.
